meta.title: Microsoft Fluent 2 (Fluent UI React v9) component catalog
meta.generatedFrom: Component names and prop types/defaults extracted from the installed @fluentui/react-components and @fluentui/web-components d.ts files; categories, a11y notes and samples authored to Fluent 2 guidance.
notes: keyProps types and @default values are taken verbatim from the shipped TypeScript definitions; props inherited from HTML elements are omitted for brevity.
webComponent is the Fluent Web Components v3 custom-element tag when one exists; null means there is no direct v3 web component (use the React component).
All components must be rendered inside a <FluentProvider theme={...}> to receive tokens.

aiCopilot.supportStatus: Published on the PUBLIC npm registry and installable, but every @fluentui-copilot/* package README states: 'For internal use only. External use is not supported at this time.' Treat these as an internal/preview surface: APIs (all 0.x) can change without notice and there is no external support SLA.
aiCopilot.githubStatus: No public source repo: https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-copilot returns 404. Source lives in the microsoft/fluentui monorepo / internal; docs at https://ai.fluentui.dev/ require Microsoft sign-in for full component pages.
aiCopilot.buildsOnFluent2: All packages peer-depend on @fluentui/react-components >=9.69.0 <10 and render inside CopilotProvider (a superset of FluentProvider), reusing Fluent 2 tokens.
aiCopilot.aggregatedFrom: @fluentui-copilot/react-copilot@0.30.5 dependency graph and each sub-package dist/index.d.ts (installed from npm).

components.name: Button
components.description: Buttons give people a way to trigger an action.
components.a11y: Renders a native <button>. Provide an aria-label when the button has only an icon. Use disabledFocusable instead of disabled to keep it in the tab order for screen-reader users.

components.a11y: A Button that opens a Menu; sets aria-haspopup and aria-expanded automatically when used as a MenuTrigger.

components.name: CompoundButton
components.description: Internal context provider used to update default values between internal components *
components.a11y: A Button with primary text plus secondaryContent (a description). Both are announced; keep secondaryContent concise.

components.name: Link
components.description: A Link is a reference to data that a user can follow by clicking or tapping it.
components.a11y: Renders <a> when href is set, otherwise a <button role="link">. Use inline within body text; give descriptive link text (avoid "click here").

components.name: Input
components.description: The Input component allows people to enter and edit text.
components.a11y: Always associate a Label (via Field or htmlFor/id). Supports contentBefore/contentAfter slots for icons or units.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: The Textarea component allows the user to enter and edit text in multiple lines.
components.a11y: Associate a Label via Field. resize controls whether the user can resize; default is none.

components.name: SpinButton
components.description: A SpinButton allows someone to incrementally adjust a value in small steps.
components.a11y: Implements role="spinbutton"; arrow keys and Page Up/Down change the value. Provide a Label via Field.

components.name: Slider
components.description: The Slider allows users to quickly select a value by dragging a thumb across a rail.
components.a11y: Renders an <input type="range">. Provide a Label via Field; keyboard arrows and Home/End adjust the value.

components.name: SearchBox
components.description: SearchBox is an Input specialized for search, with a search icon and a clear (dismiss) button.
components.a11y: Based on Input; renders type="search" with a dismiss button. Provide an aria-label or a Field label.

components.name: Field
components.description: Field adds a label, validation message and hint text to a form control.
components.a11y: Wires up label, hint and validationMessage to the child control via aria-labelledby/aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
components.sample:
<Field label="Name" required validationMessage="This field is required" validationState="error">
  <Input />
</Field>

components.name: Label
components.description: A label component provides a title or name to a component.
components.a11y: Use htmlFor to associate the Label with a control by id, or let Field manage the association.

components.name: InfoLabel
components.description: InfoLabel is a Label with an adjacent InfoButton that reveals more information in a popover.
components.a11y: The InfoButton is keyboard focusable and opens a Popover; put supplementary guidance in the info slot.
components.sample: <InfoLabel info="Shown on your public profile">Display name</InfoLabel>

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Checkboxes give people a way to select one or more items from a group, or switch between two mutually exclusive options.
components.a11y: Supports an indeterminate ("mixed") state via checked="mixed". Provide a label as children or via Field.

components.name: Radio
components.description: Radio is a wrapper for a radio button with a label; use inside a RadioGroup.
components.a11y: Must be used inside a RadioGroup, which manages roving focus and the shared name.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: RadioGroup groups related Radio items and manages single selection.
components.a11y: Implements role="radiogroup". Wrap in a Field to add a group label.
components.sample:
<Field label="Size">
  <RadioGroup defaultValue="m">
    <Radio value="s" label="Small" />
    <Radio value="m" label="Medium" />
  </RadioGroup>
</Field>

components.name: Switch
components.description: Switches enable users to trigger an option on or off.
components.a11y: Renders an <input type="checkbox" role="switch">. Provide a label via the label slot or Field.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: Combobox is a selection control that lets users choose from a list of options, with optional free typing.
components.a11y: Implements the ARIA combobox pattern (aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant). Wrap in Field for a label. Use freeform for typeable input.

components.name: Dropdown
components.description: Dropdown is a selection control that lets users choose from a list of options (no free typing).
components.a11y: Implements the ARIA combobox/listbox pattern. Selection is via Option children; supports multiselect. Wrap in Field for a label.

components.name: Select
components.description: Select is a styled wrapper around the native HTML <select> element.
components.a11y: Renders a native <select>, inheriting native keyboard and screen-reader behavior. Use <option> children and a Field label.

components.name: TagPicker
components.description: TagPicker lets users select multiple values from a list, displaying selections as dismissible tags.
components.a11y: Combines a TagGroup of selected values with a Combobox-style listbox; manages focus between input and tags.
components.sample:
<TagPicker onOptionSelect={onSelect} selectedOptions={selected}>
  <TagPickerControl>
    <TagPickerGroup>{/* selected tags */}</TagPickerGroup>
    <TagPickerInput aria-label="Assignees" />
  </TagPickerControl>
  <TagPickerList>{/* options */}</TagPickerList>
</TagPicker>

components.name: SwatchPicker
components.description: SwatchPicker lets users pick a color from a set of color swatches.
components.a11y: Implements a radiogroup of color swatches; each ColorSwatch needs an accessible name (aria-label).
components.sample:
<SwatchPicker aria-label="Theme color" defaultSelectedValue="blue">
  <ColorSwatch color="#0f6cbd" value="blue" aria-label="Blue" />
  <ColorSwatch color="#d13438" value="red" aria-label="Red" />
</SwatchPicker>

components.name: Rating
components.description: Rating lets users view and set a star (or custom icon) rating.
components.a11y: Implements a radiogroup of rating items. Provide a name and an accessible group label; itemLabel customizes per-item labels.

components.name: TabList
components.description: A tab list provides single selection from a set of tabs.
components.a11y: Implements the ARIA tabs pattern with roving tabindex. Pair each Tab value with a corresponding panel.
components.sample:
<TabList defaultSelectedValue="tab1" onTabSelect={(e, d) => setTab(d.value)}>
  <Tab value="tab1">Overview</Tab>
  <Tab value="tab2">Details</Tab>
</TabList>

components.name: Tab
components.description: A tab provides a selectable item in a tab list.
components.a11y: Rendered with role="tab"; the value links it to its panel. Manage panel visibility from the selected value.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Breadcrumb shows the path to the current location and lets users navigate back up the hierarchy.
components.a11y: Renders a <nav> with an ordered list; add aria-label="Breadcrumb". Compose BreadcrumbItem/BreadcrumbButton/BreadcrumbDivider.

components.name: Menu
components.description: Menu displays a list of actions or options in a popover triggered by a button or right-click.
components.a11y: Implements the ARIA menu pattern (menu/menuitem, arrow-key navigation). Compose MenuTrigger + MenuPopover + MenuList.

components.name: MenuItem
components.description: A single actionable item within a MenuList.
components.a11y: Rendered with role="menuitem". Variants MenuItemCheckbox/MenuItemRadio provide selectable states.

components.name: MenuList
components.description: MenuList is the container of MenuItems; it manages selection state for checkbox/radio menu items.
components.a11y: Rendered with role="menu". Use MenuItemCheckbox/MenuItemRadio children with checkedValues for selectable menus.

components.name: Nav
components.description: Nav (NavDrawer) is a vertical side navigation for moving between top-level areas of an app.

keyProps.name: multiple
keyProps.default: true, indicating that multiple categories can be open at the same time.

components.a11y: Renders a <nav> landmark; NavItem/NavCategory manage selection and expandable groups. Provide an aria-label.
components.sample:
<NavDrawer open type="inline" defaultSelectedValue="1">
  <NavDrawerBody>
    <NavItem value="1" icon={<HomeRegular />}>Home</NavItem>
    <NavItem value="2" icon={<PersonRegular />}>People</NavItem>
  </NavDrawerBody>
</NavDrawer>

components.name: Tree
components.description: Tree displays hierarchical data that users can expand, collapse and select.
components.a11y: Implements the ARIA tree pattern. Use FlatTree for large or virtualized data sets to keep the DOM flat.

components.name: Toolbar
components.description: Toolbar groups a set of related controls (buttons, toggles, menus) on a single horizontal or vertical bar.
components.a11y: Implements role="toolbar" with arrow-key navigation. Use ToolbarButton/ToolbarToggleButton/ToolbarDivider inside.
components.sample:
<Toolbar aria-label="Formatting">
  <ToolbarButton icon={<TextBoldRegular />} aria-label="Bold" />
  <ToolbarDivider />
  <ToolbarToggleButton name="align" value="left" icon={<TextAlignLeftRegular />} aria-label="Align left" />
</Toolbar>

components.name: Card
components.description: A card provides scaffolding for hosting actions and content for a single topic.
components.a11y: focusMode controls keyboard interaction (off/no-tab/tab-exit/tab-only). For selectable cards, set focusMode and onSelectionChange.
components.sample:
Quarterly report} description={Updated 2h ago} />

Body content…

components.name: CardHeader
components.description: The header region of a Card, with image, header (title) and description slots plus an optional action.
components.a11y: Uses semantic slots; put the primary title in header and secondary text in description.
components.sample: } header={Kat Larsson} description="5 min ago" action={

components.name: CardPreview
components.description: A full-bleed preview area (image/media) inside a Card, with an optional logo overlay.
components.a11y: Provide alt text on preview images; the logo slot is decorative overlay content.
components.sample: }>

components.name: CardFooter
components.description: The footer region of a Card for actions, with an optional trailing action slot.
components.a11y: Place primary/secondary actions here; keep them keyboard reachable.

components.name: Divider
components.description: A divider visually segments content into groups.
components.a11y: Decorative by default (role="separator"); when it has text children it labels the following section.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Accordion lets users show and hide sections of related content.
components.a11y: Each AccordionHeader renders a button controlling its AccordionPanel via aria-expanded/aria-controls.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Drawer contains supplementary content and is used for complex creation, edit or management experiences.
components.a11y: OverlayDrawer traps focus and renders a backdrop (dialog semantics); InlineDrawer pushes page content. Provide a DrawerHeaderTitle.

components.name: Persona
components.description: A Persona is a visual representation of a person or status showcasing an Avatar, presence, primary and secondary text.
components.a11y: Compose primary/secondary/tertiary text slots; the Avatar derives initials/color from name when no image is given.
components.sample: <Persona name="Kat Larsson" secondaryText="Available" presence={{ status: "available" }} avatar={{ image: { src: katImg } }} />

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Avatar shows a graphical representation of a person or entity via an image, initials or an icon.
components.a11y: Give a name so initials and an accessible label are generated; sizes are fixed pixel values (16–128).

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.description: AvatarGroup displays a collection of Avatars, stacked, spread, or in a pie layout, with overflow.
components.a11y: Use AvatarGroupItem for each person and AvatarGroupPopover for overflow via partitionAvatarGroupItems.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Badge is a compact status or metadata indicator, optionally with an icon.
components.a11y: Decorative by default; if the badge conveys meaning on its own, provide an accessible label on a wrapping element.

components.name: CounterBadge
components.description: CounterBadge shows a numeric count, with dot and overflow (99+) support.
components.a11y: Announce the meaning of the count on the associated control (e.g. aria-label="3 unread messages").

components.name: PresenceBadge
components.description: PresenceBadge shows a person's availability status (available, busy, away, etc.).
components.a11y: Convey status textually as well (e.g. in Persona secondary text) since color alone is not sufficient.

components.name: Table
components.description: Table presents tabular data with headers, rows and cells; the primitive, unopinionated table.
components.a11y: Renders native table elements by default (best a11y). Set noNativeElements to use div-based flex layout when you need custom layout.

components.name: DataGrid
components.description: DataGrid builds on Table to add sorting, selection, column sizing and keyboard navigation via a column-definition API.
components.a11y: Uses grid semantics with full keyboard navigation. Define columns with createTableColumn; provide items and a getRowId.
components.sample:
<DataGrid items={items} columns={columns} sortable selectionMode="multiselect">
  <DataGridHeader>
    <DataGridRow>{({ renderHeaderCell }) => <DataGridHeaderCell>{renderHeaderCell()}</DataGridHeaderCell>}</DataGridRow>
  </DataGridHeader>
  <DataGridBody>
    {({ item, rowId }) => (
      <DataGridRow key={rowId}>{({ renderCell }) => <DataGridCell>{renderCell(item)}</DataGridCell>}</DataGridRow>
    )}
  </DataGridBody>
</DataGrid>

components.name: Tag
components.description: Tag is a visual representation of an attribute, with optional media/icon, text and a dismiss action.
components.a11y: For dismissible tags, the dismiss control is keyboard focusable; use TagGroup to coordinate dismissal.
components.sample:
<TagGroup onDismiss={(e, d) => remove(d.value)}>
  <Tag dismissible value="1" media={<Avatar name="Ana" />}>Ana</Tag>
</TagGroup>

components.name: TagGroup
components.description: TagGroup is a container for multiple Tags; it provides context to size or dismiss child tags.
components.a11y: Manages roving focus across tags and fires onDismiss with the dismissed value.

components.name: Text
components.description: Text applies Fluent typography ramp styles to a block or inline run of text.
components.a11y: Prefer the semantic wrappers (Body1, Subtitle1, Title3, Caption1, Display, LargeTitle) for consistent ramp styling.

components.name: Image
components.description: Image renders an with Fluent styling options (fit, shape, shadow, border).
components.a11y: Always provide alt text; use empty alt="" for purely decorative images.
components.sample: <Image src="/hero.png" alt="Product hero" fit="cover" shape="rounded" bordered />

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Dialog is a window overlaid on the app requiring interaction, for modal or non-modal tasks.
components.a11y: Manages focus trapping and aria-modal. Compose DialogTrigger/DialogSurface/DialogBody/DialogTitle/DialogActions. modalType controls dismiss behavior.
components.sample:
<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger disableButtonEnhancement><Button>Open</Button></DialogTrigger>
  <DialogSurface>
    <DialogBody>
      <DialogTitle>Delete item?</DialogTitle>
      <DialogContent>This cannot be undone.</DialogContent>
      <DialogActions>
        <DialogTrigger disableButtonEnhancement><Button appearance="secondary">Cancel</Button></DialogTrigger>
        <Button appearance="primary">Delete</Button>
      </DialogActions>
    </DialogBody>
  </DialogSurface>
</Dialog>

components.name: Popover
components.description: Popover displays rich content in a floating surface anchored to a trigger.
components.a11y: For interactive content set trapFocus. Compose PopoverTrigger + PopoverSurface; positioning controls placement.
components.sample:
<Popover withArrow>
  <PopoverTrigger disableButtonEnhancement><Button>More info</Button></PopoverTrigger>
  <PopoverSurface>Details shown in a floating surface.</PopoverSurface>
</Popover>

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Tooltip shows a brief text label for an element on hover or focus.
components.a11y: relationship is required: "label" (names the target) or "description" (describes it). The child must be focusable to be keyboard-accessible.

components.name: TeachingPopover
components.description: TeachingPopover is a Popover for onboarding/coach-mark experiences, optionally paged as a carousel. It composes Popover, so it accepts the Popover props below.
components.a11y: Focus is trapped while open; compose TeachingPopoverSurface/Header/Body/Title/Footer and provide a dismiss control.

components.name: MessageBar
components.description: MessageBar communicates a status, message or condition inline, with intent-based styling.
components.a11y: Sets an appropriate aria-live politeness based on intent; error/warning use assertive. Compose MessageBarBody/Title/Actions.
components.sample:
<MessageBar intent="warning">
  <MessageBarBody>
    <MessageBarTitle>Storage almost full.</MessageBarTitle> Free up space to continue syncing.
  </MessageBarBody>
</MessageBar>

components.name: ProgressBar
components.description: A ProgressBar shows the progression of a task, determinate or indeterminate.
components.a11y: Renders role="progressbar". Omit value for an indeterminate bar; wrap in a Field to add a visible label.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Spinner indicates an indeterminate, ongoing operation.
components.a11y: Provide a label (or aria-label) describing what is loading; use appearance="inverted" on dark backgrounds.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Skeleton is an animated placeholder shown while content is loading.
components.a11y: Mark the loading region with aria-busy="true"; SkeletonItem defines the shape/size of each placeholder.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Toast is a transient notification; render toasts through a Toaster and dispatch them with useToastController.
components.a11y: The Toaster announces toasts politely/assertively based on intent. Give the Toaster an id and dispatch via useToastController(toasterId).

components.name: Toaster
components.description: Toaster is the container/portal that renders and positions Toast notifications.
components.a11y: Place one Toaster near the app root; it manages the aria-live region and stacking of toasts.

components.name: CopilotProvider
components.description: The required theming/context provider for Fluent AI Copilot components. It extends Fluent UI v9 FluentProvider (its context is a superset of FluentProviderContextValues) and layers Copilot-specific theme tokens and an announce (aria-live) context on top.
components.a11y: Provides a shared aria-live announcer used by chat components. Use it as the app-level provider (it supplies Fluent 2 theming); pass a theme via the theme prop.

components.name: CopilotChat
components.description: The scrollable container that lays out a conversation as a vertical list of message components (UserMessage / CopilotMessage / SystemMessage).
components.a11y: Renders the message list region; place UserMessage/CopilotMessage children inside. Pair with ScrollDownButton for long conversations.
components.sample:
<CopilotChat>
  <UserMessage>How do I center a div?</UserMessage>
  <CopilotMessage name="Copilot" loadingState="none">Use display:flex with justify-content and align-items center.</CopilotMessage>
</CopilotChat>

components.name: UserMessage
components.description: A chat bubble representing the user's message in a Copilot conversation.
components.a11y: Set announcement to control what screen readers announce when the message is added.

components.name: CopilotMessage
components.description: A chat bubble representing the AI/Copilot response, with avatar and name slots and a loading/streaming state.
components.a11y: loadingState ("loading" | "streaming" | "none") drives the busy/streaming affordance and announcements. Provide name and avatar slots to identify the assistant.
components.sample:
<CopilotMessage name="Copilot" loadingState="streaming" avatar={<Avatar name="Copilot" />}>
  Here is a summary…
</CopilotMessage>

components.name: SystemMessage
components.description: A non-conversational system/status line in a Copilot chat (e.g. "Copilot is thinking", context notices).
components.a11y: Use for status/context text; set announcement for screen-reader output.

components.name: ChatInput
components.description: The rich chat composer: a multiline editor with a send action, optional character count/limit, attachments and expand/collapse behavior. onSubmit fires with { value: string }.

keyProps.name: charactersRemainingMessage
keyProps.type: (remaining: number) => string  (required by the props union: pass a callback with maxLength, or `undefined` when unlimited)

components.a11y: Provide an aria-label (there is no placeholder prop; the editor is contentEditable). ChatInputProps is a discriminated union: charactersRemainingMessage is required (a (remaining:number)=>string callback with maxLength, or undefined without). onSubmit fires on Enter/Send; onStop cancels an in-flight response while isSending.
components.sample:
<ChatInput
  aria-label="Ask Copilot"
  maxLength={2000}
  charactersRemainingMessage={(remaining) => `${remaining} characters remaining`}
  showCount
  onSubmit={(_, data) => sendMessage(data.value)}
/>

components.name: PromptStarter
components.description: A suggested starting prompt rendered as a button, with icon, category and prompt text slots (and an optional badge). Clicking it seeds the conversation.
components.a11y: Rendered as a <button>; the category + prompt slots form its accessible name. Group multiple inside PromptStarterList.
components.sample:
<PromptStarter
  icon={<LightbulbRegular />}
  category="Draft"
  prompt="Write a project kickoff email"
  onClick={() => usePrompt("Write a project kickoff email")}
/>

components.name: PromptStarterList
components.description: A collapsible container that lays out multiple PromptStarter buttons in rows, with a show more/less toggle.
components.a11y: Manages arrow-key navigation across starters; provide expandButtonLabel/collapseButtonLabel for the toggle.
components.sample:
<PromptStarterList visibleRows={2}>
  <PromptStarter category="Draft" prompt="Write a summary" icon={<EditRegular />} />
  <PromptStarter category="Code" prompt="Explain this function" icon={<CodeRegular />} />
</PromptStarterList>

components.name: Suggestion
components.description: A single clickable follow-up suggestion / quick reply chip (built on Fluent UI Button).

keyProps.name: (extends Button)
keyProps.type: ButtonSlots — a clickable suggestion chip built on Fluent Button

components.a11y: Rendered as a button; the visible text is its accessible name. Group inside SuggestionList.
components.sample: <Suggestion onClick={() => ask("Show me an example")}>Show me an example</Suggestion>

components.name: SuggestionList
components.description: A container that lays out follow-up Suggestion chips, aligned to the start or end of the conversation.
components.a11y: Groups suggestions; horizontalAlignment ("start" | "end", default "end") aligns them under the message.

components.name: Reference
components.description: An inline citation/reference chip linking a Copilot answer to a grounding source, shown as a numbered button or link.

keyProps.name: root
keyProps.type: Slot<'button','a'> — renders as a button or anchor

keyProps.name: content
keyProps.type: Slot<'span'> — the reference label (ellipsized on overflow)

components.a11y: Rendered as a button or anchor; give it a descriptive accessible name for the source it links to.

components.name: ReferenceList
components.description: A container that lays out multiple Reference citations, with overflow handling.
components.a11y: Groups references; use ReferenceOverflowButton for overflow when there are many sources.

components.name: Citation
components.description: An inline superscript citation marker (e.g. a numbered footnote) placed within Copilot answer text.
components.a11y: Provide an accessible label describing the cited source.
components.sample: Machine learning is a subset of AI<Citation>1</Citation>.

components.name: FeedbackButtons
components.description: Thumbs up / thumbs down controls letting users rate a Copilot response.
components.a11y: Each button is an independent toggle; selected ("positive" | "negative") reflects the current rating. Provide aria-labels for the up/down actions.

components.name: OutputCard
components.description: A surface that frames rich Copilot output (generated content, canvas/sidecar experiences), with a loading state.
components.a11y: Set isLoading to expose a busy state while content streams; mode ("canvas" | "sidecar") selects the layout.

components.name: LatencyLoader
components.description: An animated "Copilot is working" latency/loading indicator shown while awaiting a response.
components.a11y: Conveys a busy state; pair with descriptive text so screen readers announce that a response is being generated. LatencyCancel lets the user stop generation.

components.name: SendButton
components.description: The submit/stop button used inside ChatInput; shows a send icon, a stop state while sending, and an optional dictation state.
components.a11y: Toggles between "send" and "stop" affordances via isSending; provide an aria-label for each state.

components.name: ResponseCount
components.description: A small indicator of remaining/consumed responses or quota status in a Copilot experience.
components.a11y: status ("success" | "warning" | "danger") should be paired with text, not conveyed by color alone.

components.name: AiGeneratedDisclaimer
components.description: A standardized "AI-generated content may be incorrect" disclaimer line for Copilot surfaces.
components.a11y: Static informative text; keep it visible near the chat input or responses.

components.name: Timestamp
components.description: A relative/absolute timestamp label attached to a chat message.
components.a11y: Provide a full date/time as an accessible label when showing a relative time.
